findings.current: A being born from darkness had no reason to understand what darkness was.
findings.defect: The draft changes an assertion that such a being does not understand darkness into a claim that it merely has no reason to understand it.
findings.rationale: The source describes the inherent ignorance of a being born in darkness, not its lack of motivation or reason to understand darkness.
findings.replacement: A being born from darkness does not know what darkness means.
findings.source: 어둠에서 태어난 존재는 어둠이라는 의미를 모른다.

findings.current: He had made the ten Death Knights under his command the commanders of five legions, then come here as the vanguard of one of them.
findings.defect: The draft turns the black knight himself into the vanguard rather than preserving his role as the vanguard commander.
findings.rationale: 선봉장 is the commander or leader of a vanguard, so the source assigns him a command role rather than identifying him with the vanguard unit itself.
findings.replacement: He had appointed the ten Death Knights under his command to lead five legions, then personally taken command of one legion’s vanguard and come here.
findings.source: 휘하에 놓인 열 기의 데스나이트를 다섯 군단의 사령관으로 삼고, 스스로 한 군단의 선봉장이 되어 이곳에 왔다.

findings.current: At the next command, more than two hundred Dullahans formed ranks.
findings.defect: The draft makes the quantity strictly greater than two hundred, while 이백여 indicates an approximate count.
findings.rationale: The source gives an estimated quantity of around two hundred rather than a firm lower bound above two hundred.
findings.replacement: At the next command, roughly two hundred Dullahans formed ranks.
findings.source: 이어지는 지시에 이백여 기의 듀라한(Dullahan)이 정렬했다.

findings.defect: The two fragments jointly order the troops to prepare for a charge, but the draft first commands them to charge immediately and only afterward says to prepare.
findings.rationale: 돌격 준비 means preparation for a charge. This occurs before the spearheads are lowered and before the legion actually begins advancing, so converting it into an immediate charge changes the action sequence.

findings.current: The undead legion covering the vast granary advanced slowly behind its commander.
findings.defect: “Granary” denotes a storage building and does not fit an army spread over sprouting farmland; 곡창 here means a broad grain-producing region or breadbasket.
findings.rationale: The surrounding description places the army across expansive cultivated land, not on or inside a grain-storage structure.
findings.replacement: The undead legion blanketing the vast breadbasket advanced slowly behind its commander.
findings.source: 드넓은 곡창(穀倉)을 뒤덮은 언데드 군단이 자신들의 사령관을 따라 천천히 진격한다.

findings.defect: The draft makes teleportation categorically impossible, although the subsequent discussion establishes that it remains possible but carries an extreme risk.
findings.rationale: 곤란해 expresses that the attempt is difficult or problematic in the present circumstances; Johnson immediately explains that interference could kill them rather than saying teleportation cannot be performed.

findings.current: —Yes. But if you die a dog’s death during the teleportation process, even more people will become casualties.
findings.defect: “Die a dog’s death” is an opaque literal calque of 개죽음을 당하다, whose meaning here is to die pointlessly or for nothing.
findings.rationale: Johnson is warning that Jin’s needless death would worsen the broader casualty count; the Korean idiom does not refer literally to the manner of a dog’s death.
findings.replacement: —Yes. But if you get yourself killed for nothing during the teleportation, there’ll be even more casualties.
findings.source: 「그래. 하지만 텔레포트를 하는 과정에서 네가 개죽음을 당한다면, 더 많은 사상자가 나오겠지.」

findings.current: I snorted quietly as I watched Magic Johnson mutter one curse after another.
findings.defect: “Snorted” can suggest disdain or irritation and omits the source’s explicit brief laugh.
findings.rationale: 피식 웃었다 explicitly describes a short, subdued laugh prompted by Jin already understanding Johnson’s reaction.
findings.replacement: I let out a quiet laugh as I watched Magic Johnson mutter one curse after another.
findings.source: 쉴 새 없이 욕설을 중얼거리는 매직 존슨을 보며 나는 피식 웃었다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it alters one preparatory command into an immediate action, weakens two causal or hierarchical details, and contains several localized quantity, idiom, and wording errors.
